backup-web-test.title: Software Developer
backup-web-test.subtitle: R-103214 · EP MEA · MedTech
backup-web-test.summary: Medical-supply contract and tender oversight strengthens the functional match. Confirm four relevant years and commercial tools; the P5 experienced-analyst grade may be lateral.
gaps: Bachelor’s degree; 4+ years bids, tendering, pricing or commercial operations.
Arabic and English; advanced Excel/PowerPoint. SAP is an advantage.
steps: Check your employer application history for R-103214. Track an existing submission rather than sending a duplicate; otherwise confirm four relevant years before applying.
Show bid compliance, tender turnaround, reporting and cycle-time improvements you personally delivered.
Ask about grade, decision authority, fixed pay and bonus. Do not assume this is a management promotion.
Open the official role, select Apply and complete your own account/application. Review the parsed CV and every answer before submission.
Keep the acknowledgement and mark the application locally. Check the closing date on the employer page.
